# DiffBinaryVectors

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/DiffBinaryVectors`

Manual: [DiffBinaryVectors (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/DiffBinaryVectors.md)

```text
DiffBinaryVectors, version 0.01

Usage: DiffBinaryVectors [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --states : names of the two vector files (multiple arguments)
    --min-range : compare vectors starting from a given component (is negative, start couting from the last component) from  (default value = 0)
    --max-range : compare vectors up to a given component (0 if up to the end) (default value = 0)
    -e, --error : rounding error (default value = 0)
    --discard-zero : do not compare components if the one the first start is strictly zero
    --relative-error : compute relative error
    --rational : input vectors are rational vectors
    --complex : input vectors are complex vectors
    --magnitude : only compare the coefficients magnitude (not available for rational vectors)
    --fix-phase : fix the phase of a given component for each vector to be real and positive (negative if no phase fixing should be performed) (default value = -1)
    --use-longlong : use 128bit(64bits) integers instead of 64bits(32bits) integers in rational mode

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
